funding_audit.gap_interpretation: funding events are recorded event observations; no synthetic events are inserted

resampling.completeness_rule: all exact 1m constituents required; partial/incomplete buckets omitted and no prices forward-filled
resampling.zero_trade_bar_rule: Within a bucket containing trades, OHLC comes from minute rows with trade_count > 0 (matching native Binance candles, which ignore zero-trade minute OHLC); if the complete bucket has no trades, use the official zero-count minute OHLC as published. Volume and trade-count sums include every constituent row.

ema.native_indicator_execution_seed: SMA of first N completed closes, then recursive alpha=2/(N+1); periods 20/50; readiness after 20/50 completed execution bars (B0 source requires >55 chart bars, so profile gates use 56)
ema.custom_htf_seed: first completed HTF close after reset, then recursive alpha=2/(N+1); readiness requires 250 contiguous completed HTF bars

interpretation: This is a provenance, coverage, continuity, aggregation, and indicator-warmup audit. It is not a profitability result. Missing archive rows and incomplete buckets are reported and excluded rather than synthesized.
